Feature: Alarms
  As a user
  I want the system to trigger alarms for various conditions
  So that I can take corrective action

  Scenario: Alarm for blocked input air line
    Given the input air line is blocked
    When the system detects the blockage
    Then the alarm for low pressure should be triggered with severity HIGH

  Scenario: Alarm for blocked input O2 line
    Given the input O2 line is blocked
    When the system detects the blockage
    Then the alarm for low pressure should be triggered with severity HIGH

  Scenario: Alarm for inspiratory pressure dropping below -4cm H2O
    Given the inspiratory pressure is -5cm H2O
    When the system detects the drop
    Then the alarm for low pressure should be triggered

  Scenario: Alarm for input O2 line pressure too high
    Given the input O2 line pressure is 80cm H2O
    When the system detects the high pressure
    Then the alarm for high pressure should be triggered with severity HIGH

  Scenario: Alarm for overpressure above 60cm H2O
    Given the inspiratory pressure is 70cm H2O
    When the system detects the overpressure
    Then the alarm for overpressure should be triggered

  Scenario: Alarm for GUI unresponsiveness
    Given the GUI is unresponsive for 1/2 of the apnea time
    When the system detects the unresponsiveness
    Then the alarm for GUI unresponsiveness should be triggered

  Scenario: Alarm for controller unresponsiveness
    Given the controller is unresponsive for 1/2 of the apnea time
    When the system detects the unresponsiveness
    Then the alarm for controller unresponsiveness should be triggered

  Scenario Outline: Alarm for blocked input air line with different pressures
    Given the input air line is blocked with pressure <pressure>
    When the system detects the blockage
    Then the alarm for low pressure should be triggered with severity HIGH
    Examples:
      | pressure |
      | 0cm H2O  | # Normal pressure
      | -5cm H2O | # Low pressure
      | 80cm H2O | # High pressure

  Scenario Outline: Alarm for blocked input O2 line with different pressures
    Given the input O2 line is blocked with pressure <pressure>
    When the system detects the blockage
    Then the alarm for low pressure should be triggered with severity HIGH
    Examples:
      | pressure |
      | 0cm H2O  | # Normal pressure
      | -5cm H2O | # Low pressure
      | 80cm H2O | # High pressure

  Scenario Outline: Alarm for inspiratory pressure dropping below -4cm H2O with different pressures
    Given the inspiratory pressure is <pressure>
    When the system detects the drop
    Then the alarm for low pressure should be triggered
    Examples:
      | pressure |
      | -5cm H2O | # Below threshold
      | -3cm H2O | # At threshold
      | 0cm H2O  | # Above threshold

  Scenario Outline: Alarm for input O2 line pressure too high with different pressures
    Given the input O2 line pressure is <pressure>
    When the system detects the high pressure
    Then the alarm for high pressure should be triggered with severity HIGH
    Examples:
      | pressure |
      | 60cm H2O | # At threshold
      | 70cm H2O | # Above threshold
      | 80cm H2O | # High pressure

  Scenario Outline: Alarm for overpressure above 60cm H2O with different pressures
    Given the inspiratory pressure is <pressure>
    When the system detects the overpressure
    Then the alarm for overpressure should be triggered
    Examples:
      | pressure |
      | 60cm H2O | # At threshold
      | 70cm H2O | # Above threshold
      | 80cm H2O | # High pressure
